title: Lesson 5 - Choosing Agentforce Sales features: cadences, inbox, territories, forecasting, and Einstein
description: Identify when to use Agentforce Sales features and related products such as Sales Engagement, Salesforce Inbox, Enterprise Territory Management, Opportunity Forecasting, Agentforce Sales Einstein, and generative/predictive AI.

questions.question: A team requires reps to follow a repeatable multi-touch sequence of calls, emails, and tasks, with a prioritised call list each morning. Which feature fits?
questions.explanation: Sales Engagement cadences drive the sequenced multi-touch steps and the Work Queue prioritises who to contact, while forecasting only rolls up commit numbers.

questions.question: An org reassigns accounts to territories that do not match its role hierarchy and wants to test a new carve before it goes live. Which feature do you configure?
questions.explanation: Enterprise Territory Management has its own territory hierarchy and model versions you preview then activate, which is exactly what this requirement describes.

questions.question: Managers need a weekly roll-up of each rep's Commit and Best Case amounts against quota. Which feature delivers that?
questions.explanation: Opportunity Forecasting rolls forecast categories up against quota, whereas scoring returns a propensity and the other two drive activity or mailbox logging.
